# Parameter Specification: KickDesigner2

**Status:** 🔒 Locked (immutable contract for implementation) — **v1**

**CRITICAL CONTRACT:** This specification is immutable during implementation (Stages 1–3). All stages reference these exact parameter IDs, ranges, defaults, and types.

**Generated by:** `/dream` → plugin-ideation → deep-research → plugin-planning precondition satisfaction, derived from the user's authoritative spec + `creative-brief.md` + `research-notes.md`.
**Generated date:** 2026-08-28
**UI:** native JUCE (no WebView mockup yaml — control types specified inline here)
**Referenced by:** Stage 1 (Foundation / APVTS), Stage 2 (DSP), Stage 3 (GUI)

## Total Parameter Count

**45 APVTS parameters:** 41 Float, 3 Choice (`noiseType`, `oversampling`, `tuneMode`), 1 Bool (`limiter`). Plus 3 non-automatable UI actions (Randomize, Mutate, Save — NOT in APVTS) → 48 total controls.

> _Header corrected 2026-08-28: earlier drafts said "49 / 42 Float"; enumerating the group sections below yields 41 Float / 45 APVTS. `bodyAttack` is deliberately not exposed (see Stage 0 Addendum, Open Q 9). Implementation targets the 45 parameters mapped in `architecture.md`._

Skew factors below are chosen so the listed default sits near the knob's centre; Stage 1 may refine within ±0.1. All Float params: `AudioParameterFloat`; all support host automation.

---

## PITCH group

### Fundamental
- **ID:** `fundamental` · **Float** · **25.0 – 150.0 Hz** · **Default 55.0** · **Skew 0.5** · **Unit Hz**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Pitch panel. Value `{v} Hz`.
- **DSP:** final target frequency of body + pitch envelope. In `Fixed Frequency` tune mode this is the absolute fundamental regardless of MIDI note. In `MIDI Pitch` mode the incoming note sets the fundamental and this knob is a global offset reference / fallback (Stage 0 to confirm exact interaction — see Open Questions).

### Pitch Start
- **ID:** `pitchStart` · **Float** · **1.0 – 10.0 ×** · **Default 4.0** · **Skew 0.6** · **Unit ×**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Pitch panel. Value `{v.2f}×`.
- **DSP:** pitch-envelope start frequency = `fundamental × pitchStart`. Envelope falls from here to `fundamental`. Operates in ratio/log domain — never linear Hz.

### Pitch Time
- **ID:** `pitchTime` · **Float** · **5.0 – 500.0 ms** · **Default 50.0** · **Skew 0.3** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Pitch panel. Value `{v.0f} ms`.
- **DSP:** time for the pitch envelope to fall from start to (near) fundamental.

### Pitch Curve
- **ID:** `pitchCurve` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.7** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Pitch panel. Value `{v.0%}` or `Lin … Exp`.
- **DSP:** 0.0 = near-linear fall (more audible sweep / "laser"), 1.0 = sharp exponential spike (punch). The envelope shape is implemented as a snap+settle contour (fast initial collapse, slower approach to fundamental) whose sharpness is driven by this control — no separate second parameter. See research-notes §1.

---

## BODY group

### Body Level
- **ID:** `bodyLevel` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 1.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —** (internally gain, `-inf…0 dB`)
- **UI:** rotary knob, Body panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** linear level of the body oscillator layer into the summing bus.

### Body Decay
- **ID:** `bodyDecay` · **Float** · **20.0 – 2000.0 ms** · **Default 400.0** · **Skew 0.4** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Body panel. Value `{v.0f} ms`.
- **DSP:** exponential decay time of the body amplitude envelope. Attack is fixed-fast internally (~1–3 ms, click-free); no separate attack parameter exposed (the spec's 0–20 ms amp attack is covered by `transientAttack` shaping + the fixed fast attack — Stage 0 to confirm whether a dedicated `bodyAttack` is warranted; default assumption: not exposed).

### Body Harmonics
- **ID:** `bodyHarmonics` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.15** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Body panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** blends added harmonic content / controlled pre-distortion saturation into the body oscillator (clean sine at 0.0 → rich harmonic body at 1.0). Distinct from the main Drive stage; this shapes the body's own timbre before summing.

---

## SUB group

### Sub Level
- **ID:** `subLevel` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.5** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Sub panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** level of the independent clean sub sine layer. Generated mono, summed identically to L and R.

### Sub Frequency
- **ID:** `subFreq` · **Float** · **25.0 – 80.0 Hz** · **Default 40.0** · **Skew 0.57** · **Unit Hz**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Sub panel. Value `{v.1f} Hz`.
- **DSP:** fixed frequency of the sub oscillator (independent of the pitch envelope). Phase reset to 0 on every trigger for phase stability.

### Sub Decay
- **ID:** `subDecay` · **Float** · **20.0 – 2000.0 ms** · **Default 300.0** · **Skew 0.35** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Sub panel. Value `{v.0f} ms`.
- **DSP:** exponential decay of the sub layer's amplitude envelope.

---

## CLICK group

### Click Level
- **ID:** `clickLevel` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.4** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Click panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** level of the synthesized click/transient layer (no samples).

### Click Tone
- **ID:** `clickTone` · **Float** · **1000.0 – 15000.0 Hz** · **Default 4000.0** · **Skew 0.45** · **Unit Hz**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Click panel. Value `{v.0f} Hz` / `{v.1f} kHz` above 1000.
- **DSP:** centre frequency of the click's band-pass-filtered noise burst.

### Click Time
- **ID:** `clickTime` · **Float** · **0.1 – 50.0 ms** · **Default 3.0** · **Skew 0.25** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Click panel. Value `{v.1f} ms`.
- **DSP:** duration (AD envelope length) of the click layer.

### Click Pitch
- **ID:** `clickPitch` · **Float** · **1000.0 – 15000.0 Hz** · **Default 5000.0** · **Skew 0.55** · **Unit Hz**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Click panel. Value `{v.0f} Hz` / kHz.
- **DSP:** frequency of the click's tonal transient oscillator component (with its own fast pitch drop).

---

## TAIL group

### Tail Level
- **ID:** `tailLevel` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.3** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tail panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** level of the sustained tail layer (derived from the body or a dedicated LF oscillator — Stage 0 decides).

### Tail Length
- **ID:** `tailLength` · **Float** · **20.0 – 2000.0 ms** · **Default 200.0** · **Skew 0.3** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tail panel. Value `{v.0f} ms`.
- **DSP:** decay time of the tail. Short = tight, long = droning/rumble.

### Tail Tone
- **ID:** `tailTone` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.5** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tail panel. Value `{v.0%}` / `Dark … Bright`.
- **DSP:** low-pass / tilt filter cutoff on the tail (dark→bright).

### Tail Drive
- **ID:** `tailDrive` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.2** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tail panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** saturation amount applied to the tail only (independent of main Drive). Processed inside oversampling.

## NOISE group

### Noise Level
- **ID:** `noiseLevel` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Noise panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** level of the optional noise layer (default off).

### Noise Decay
- **ID:** `noiseDecay` · **Float** · **20.0 – 500.0 ms** · **Default 60.0** · **Skew 0.28** · **Unit ms**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Noise panel. Value `{v.0f} ms`.
- **DSP:** exponential decay of the noise layer's amplitude envelope.

### Noise Tone
- **ID:** `noiseTone` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.5** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Noise panel. Value `{v.0%}` / `Dark … Bright`.
- **DSP:** filter cutoff / tilt on the noise layer.

### Noise Type ⚠️ CHOICE
- **ID:** `noiseType` · **Choice** (`AudioParameterChoice`)
- **Choices (index 0–2):** `["White", "Pink", "Filtered"]`
- **Default index:** 0 (`"White"`)
- **UI:** small dropdown, Noise panel.
- **DSP:** selects the noise generator colour. "Filtered" = band-passed white driven by `noiseTone` as centre freq.

## TRANSIENT group

### Transient Attack
- **ID:** `transientAttack` · **Float** · **-1.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (bipolar, centre detent)** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Transient panel, centre-detented. Value signed `{+v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** kick-tuned transient enhancement — boosts (>0) or softens (<0) the initial attack portion of the summed signal. Simple envelope-follower design, not a full transient designer.

### Transient Sustain
- **ID:** `transientSustain` · **Float** · **-1.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (bipolar, centre detent)** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Transient panel, centre-detented. Value signed `{+v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** boosts (>0) or reduces (<0) the body/sustain portion after the attack.

---

## DISTORTION group

### Drive
- **ID:** `drive` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.3** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —** (maps to ~0 … +36 dB pre-gain)
- **UI:** rotary knob, Drive panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** input gain into the waveshaper. Subtle saturation at low values → hard-techno destruction near 1.0. Processed inside oversampling.

### Character
- **ID:** `character` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Drive panel. Value `{v.0%}` + style label (e.g. `Tanh`, `Cubic`, `Fold`).
- **DSP:** continuous morph position along the ordered chain
  `tanh → cubic → asymmetric → soft-clip → hard-clip → foldback → bitcrush`.
  Crossfades the two bracketing transfer functions (equal-gain / mild parabolic law). Each stage is loudness-compensated (adaptive short-window RMS makeup) so sweeping `character` does not jump in level. See research-notes §3.

### Drive Mix
- **ID:** `driveMix` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 1.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Drive panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** parallel blend of clean (pre-shaper) and distorted signal. Keeps sub/body intact under extreme drive.

---

## TONE group (simple 3-band, NOT a mastering EQ)

### Low
- **ID:** `low` · **Float** · **-12.0 – 12.0 dB** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (centre detent)** · **Unit dB**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tone panel, centre-detented. Value signed `{+v.1f} dB`.
- **DSP:** low shelf, ~120 Hz corner. High-quality IIR.

### Mid
- **ID:** `mid` · **Float** · **-12.0 – 12.0 dB** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (centre detent)** · **Unit dB**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tone panel, centre-detented. Value signed `{+v.1f} dB`.
- **DSP:** bell, ~600–900 Hz, moderate Q.

### High
- **ID:** `high` · **Float** · **-12.0 – 12.0 dB** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (centre detent)** · **Unit dB**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tone panel, centre-detented. Value signed `{+v.1f} dB`.
- **DSP:** high shelf, ~4–6 kHz corner.

**Tone position:** pre-distortion by default (keeps heavy drive "tight and controlled" per research §3) — Stage 0 to confirm / consider switchable.

## STEREO group (sub & lows always mono)

### Body Width
- **ID:** `bodyWidth` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Stereo panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** widening applied only to body content above the mono crossover (~120–150 Hz).

### Click Width
- **ID:** `clickWidth` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.3** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Stereo panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** widening of the click/transient (high-frequency) content.

### Output Width
- **ID:** `outputWidth` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.5** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —** (0.5 = unity / natural)
- **UI:** rotary knob, Stereo panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** global M/S width on the final bus, applied above the mono crossover only. 0.0 = mono, 0.5 = unity, 1.0 = max wide.

---

## OUTPUT group

### Output
- **ID:** `output` · **Float** · **-24.0 – 12.0 dB** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit dB**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Output strip. Value signed `{+v.1f} dB`.
- **DSP:** final output gain (`Decibels::decibelsToGain`), applied after Mix, before the safety limiter.
- **Note (`defaultNormalised`):** 0 dB in a -24…+12 range normalises to `(0-(-24))/(12-(-24)) = 24/36 ≈ 0.6667`, not 0.5 — double-click-reset must target 0.6667.

### Mix
- **ID:** `mix` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 1.0** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Output strip. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** dry/wet blend for the whole instrument. As a synth instrument the "dry" path is silence unless fed audio; primarily useful in the few hosts that route sidechain/aux in. Equal-power crossfade. (Stage 0 may recommend demoting to a fixed 100% if it has no meaningful use for an instrument.)

### Limiter ⚠️ BOOL
- **ID:** `limiter` · **Bool** (`AudioParameterBool`) · **Default true**
- **UI:** toggle, Output strip / global.
- **DSP:** engages the transient-preserving safety stage. **Default design: zero-latency soft-clip ceiling at ~-0.5 dBFS** (no added latency, preserves the kick peak). Off = raw output (can exceed 0 dBFS). See Open Questions for the optional short-lookahead true-limiter mode.

---

## GLOBAL group

### Oversampling ⚠️ CHOICE
- **ID:** `oversampling` · **Choice** (`AudioParameterChoice`)
- **Choices (index 0–3):** `["1x", "2x", "4x", "8x"]`
- **Default index:** **1 (`"2x"`)** — provisional; Stage 17 CPU profiling confirms 2x vs 4x. **AD-10:** the OS region wraps the *entire* voice + master chain through the safety limiter (all layer oscillators/noise, `bodyHarmonics`, `tailDrive`, tone, transient, master morph, stereo, mix, gain, `tanh` limiter). Only the final DC blocker + analyzer taps are base-rate. `8×` = "high CPU".
- **UI:** dropdown / segmented control, global strip.
- **DSP:** `juce::dsp::Oversampling` (`numChannels = 2`, `filterHalfBandPolyphaseIIR`, `useIntegerLatency = true`), one pre-built object per factor at `prepareToPlay` (runtime rebuild is NOT audio-thread safe). Switching: ~64-sample fade → swap atomic pointer → `reset()` → audio-thread recompute of all in-region coefficients for the new `fsOversampled` → `setLatencySamples()` (message thread). Report total latency = `round(activeOs->getLatencyInSamples())` (limiter adds 0).

---

## TUNING group

### Tune Mode ⚠️ CHOICE
- **ID:** `tuneMode` · **Choice** (`AudioParameterChoice`)
- **Choices (index 0–1):** `["MIDI Pitch", "Fixed Frequency"]`
- **Default index:** 0 (`"MIDI Pitch"`)
- **UI:** dropdown, Tuning panel / header.
- **DSP:** `MIDI Pitch` = incoming note number sets the fundamental. `Fixed Frequency` = `fundamental` param is the absolute fundamental regardless of note (note still triggers).

### Tune
- **ID:** `tune` · **Float** · **-24.0 – 24.0 semitones** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (centre detent)** · **Unit st**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tuning panel. Value signed `{+v.0f} st`.
- **DSP:** coarse transpose of the resulting fundamental (both tune modes).

### Fine Tune
- **ID:** `fineTune` · **Float** · **-100.0 – 100.0 cents** · **Default 0.0** · **Skew linear (centre detent)** · **Unit ct**
- **UI:** rotary knob, Tuning panel. Value signed `{+v.0f} ct`.
- **DSP:** fine transpose in cents.

---

## VELOCITY group

### Velocity Sensitivity
- **ID:** `velSensitivity` · **Float** · **0.0 – 1.0** · **Default 0.5** · **Skew linear** · **Unit —**
- **UI:** rotary knob, header / Tuning panel. Value `{v.0%}`.
- **DSP:** single control for velocity response. Internally fixed routing: strong influence on amplitude/level, moderate on click level, subtle on pitch-start amount. 0.0 = velocity ignored (always full). "Sensible without unnecessary complexity" per spec — no per-target velocity knobs.

---

## MACRO group (automatable; non-destructive bipolar offsets to targets)

All four: **Float · 0.0 – 1.0 · Default 0.5 · Skew linear · Unit —**. UI: four large rotary knobs, top macro row. Value `{v.0%}`.

At 0.5 a macro is neutral (zero contribution). Away from centre it adds a smoothed bipolar offset to its target parameters' effective values in the audio engine (the underlying APVTS target params are unchanged and still independently automatable). Exact curves are tuned in Stage 2 for musical results.

| ID | Name | Targets (effective-value offset) |
|---|---|---|
| `macroPunch` | PUNCH | `transientAttack` +, `pitchStart` +, `pitchTime` − (tighter), click level + |
| `macroBody` | BODY | `bodyLevel` +, `bodyDecay` +, `fundamental` − (deeper) |
| `macroCrush` | CRUSH | `drive` +, `character` + (toward digital) |
| `macroTail` | TAIL | `tailLevel` +, `tailLength` +, `tailTone` + |

## Non-Automatable UI Actions (NOT APVTS parameters)

- **Randomize** — constrained musical randomisation (genre-aware per-param bounds, correlated where needed). Undoable. Does not touch `oversampling`, `limiter`, `output`, `mix`, tuning, `velSensitivity`, or macros.
- **Mutate** — small bounded perturbation (±5–15%) around the current patch. Same exclusions. Undoable.
- **Save** — write current APVTS state as a user preset to disk.

Undo/redo backed by `APVTS.undoManager` (attach an `UndoManager` to the APVTS).

---

## State / Serialization

- `juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState` is the single source of truth. `getStateInformation` / `setStateInformation` round-trip the full APVTS `state` tree (XML → binary) plus a top-level `stateVersion` attribute (=1) for future migration.
- Current preset name/path stored alongside APVTS state (non-parameter property on the value tree).
- UI never holds authoritative state.

## Signal-Flow Order (DSP)

```
[Oversample ▲]  ── whole voice + master chain runs inside one OS region (AD-10) ──────────────┐
   trigger → [BodyOsc + PitchEnv + AmpEnv + bodyHarmonics] ┐                                   │
             [SubOsc + SubEnv]                              ├─ sum → Tone(pre) → TransientShaper│
             [ClickGen]                                     │   → Drive/Character/DriveMix       │
             [TailGen + tailDrive]                          │   → Stereo (mono <130 Hz; body/click/output width) │
             [NoiseGen + NoiseEnv]                         ┘   → Mix → Output gain → Safety Limiter (tanh) │
[Oversample ▼] ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   → DC blocker (base rate) → analyzer taps → out
```
(Macros apply as effective-value offsets at each stage's parameter read. **Stage 0 RESOLVED:** Tone is fixed pre-distortion; the OS region wraps everything through the safety limiter so every nonlinearity — `bodyHarmonics`, `tailDrive`, master morph, `tanh` limiter — is oversampled by construction. See `architecture.md` AD-10.)

## Open Questions for Stage 0 (from research-notes §"Open questions")

1. **Default oversampling** — 2× (provisional) vs 4× after CPU profiling.
2. **Safety limiter** — confirm zero-latency soft-clip ceiling as default; spec the optional short-lookahead (+1–2 ms, reported) true-limiter mode and whether it's a `limiterMode` choice or hidden.
3. **Distortion morph** — lock the 7-stage ordering; choose adaptive-RMS makeup (recommended) vs static per-curve gain tables.
4. **Tone position** — pre-distortion (recommended) vs post vs switchable.
5. **Pitch envelope** — snap+settle contour driven by `pitchCurve` (recommended, no extra param) vs exposing a second stage control.
6. **Mono crossover** — fix at ~130 Hz (recommended) vs expose.
7. **Click blend** — noise/transient-osc/impulse weightings; generate click inside the oversampled block (recommended when `drive` > 0).
8. **`fundamental` behaviour in `MIDI Pitch` mode** — global offset vs ignored-fallback.
9. **`bodyAttack`** — keep fixed-fast internal (recommended) vs expose 0–20 ms param per original spec's AMPLITUDE section.
10. **`mix`** — keep as instrument dry/wet (rarely useful) vs fix at 100%.

## Contract Rules

Immutable during implementation:
- ✅ Stage 1 (Foundation) reads this to generate APVTS (`Parameters/ParameterIDs.h`, `ParameterLayout.h`)
- ✅ Stage 2 (DSP) reads this to implement processing
- ✅ Stage 3 (GUI) reads this to verify every control binds to the correct parameter ID

Stage 0 planning MAY refine skew factors (±0.1), resolve the Open Questions above, and adjust internal DSP corner frequencies — but MUST NOT add/remove/rename automatable parameters or change ranges/defaults without a new version of this file.

## Stage 0 Addendum (2026-08-28, research-planning-agent) — non-breaking

Stage 0 planning resolved the Open Questions and set internal DSP constants. **No automatable parameter was added, removed, renamed, re-ranged, or re-defaulted.** Skew factors are accepted as-is from v1 (all already place the default near knob centre within the ±0.1 allowance). Full rationale in `architecture.md` → *Architecture Decisions*; summary in `plan.md` → *Open Questions — RESOLVED*.

**Open Question resolutions:**
1. Default `oversampling` = **`2x`** (index 1) provisional; confirm at repo Stage 17 profiling.
2. Safety limiter (`limiter = on`) = **zero-latency soft-clip ceiling at −0.5 dBFS** (0 added latency). Short-lookahead true-limiter mode is **NOT in v1** (would require a new parameter + latency reporting → future spec version).
3. Distortion `character` morph order = **`tanh → cubic → asymmetric → soft-clip → hard-clip → foldback → bitcrush`** (this file is authoritative; the creative-brief signal-flow ASCII lists a different order and is superseded). Equal-gain linear crossfade of adjacent curves. Loudness compensation = **adaptive short-window RMS makeup** seeded by a static per-curve prime table (static 2-D `curve×drive` LUT retained as fallback).
4. `low`/`mid`/`high` tone = **fixed pre-distortion** (not switchable).
5. Pitch envelope = **single `pitchCurve`-driven normalised-exponential snap+settle**, `k = 0.6 + pitchCurve·8.4`, `f(t) = fundamentalEff · pitchStartEff^{e(τ)}`, phase-integrated. No second parameter.
6. Stereo mono crossover = **fixed 130 Hz** (Linkwitz-Riley).
7. Click blend = **0.50 filtered-noise burst + 0.35 transient osc (own pitch drop) + 0.15 windowed raised-cosine impulse**; generated **inside the OS region** (see AD-10 below) AND band-limited by construction (impulse window ≥ 8 samples at `fsOversampled`).
8. `fundamental` in `MIDI Pitch` mode = **global semitone offset** `12·log2(fundamental / 55)` added to the MIDI-note pitch (0 at the 55 Hz default); absolute fundamental in `Fixed Frequency` mode.
9. `bodyAttack` = **kept fixed-fast internal** (`kBodyAttackMs = 2.0`, raised-cosine). Not exposed. Soft-attack need is covered by negative `transientAttack`.
10. `mix` = **kept automatable** but defined as an **equal-power blend between the processed output and silence** (an instrument has an output-only bus → no dry path). Acts as an automatable fade/mute; recommend leaving at 100 %.

**AD-10 (2026-08-28, added after implementer review) — oversampling scope:** the OS region wraps the **entire voice + master chain through the safety limiter**, not just the master waveshaper. `bodyHarmonics`, `tailDrive`, the master morph and the `tanh` limiter ceiling are all nonlinearities and are all oversampled by construction; the "body sat at base rate because the fundamental is low" reasoning in the original draft is retracted (a base-rate `tanh` on a 1.5 kHz sine aliases immediately). Linear stages run in-region too for a single up/down pair. `processSamplesUp` is fed a zero block (no audio input); `processSamplesDown` runs after the limiter; only the DC blocker + analyzer taps are base-rate. Documented Stage-17 escape hatch: render the pure-sine layers at base rate and up-sample if 4×/8× CPU is excessive. Full detail: `architecture.md` → AD-10.

**Internal DSP constants set in Stage 0** (not parameters; Stage 2 may tune). All in-region coefficients use `fsOversampled = fs · osFactor` and are recomputed on factor change:
- Tone corners: low shelf 130 Hz · mid bell 750 Hz (Q 0.7) · high shelf 5 kHz.
- Mono/width crossover: 130 Hz. Final-bus DC blocker corner: ~5 Hz (base rate). Body-path DC blocker: ~30 Hz (in-region).
- Fixed body attack: 2.0 ms. Retrigger crossfade: 3.0 ms equal-power. OS-switch fade: ~64 samples.
- Distortion `drive` maps to 0…+36 dB pre-gain. RMS makeup window ~10 ms, smoothing ~30 ms, clamp ±12 dB.
- Click impulse window: `≈0.18 ms` raised-cosine (≥ 8 samples at 44.1 kHz base rate → more at `fsOversampled`). Limiter ceiling: −0.5 dBFS. Limiter lookahead: 0 samples.
- Analyzer: FFT order 11 (2048), Hann window, 30 fps Timer repaint, waveform capture 16384 samples.
- Oversampling: `filterHalfBandPolyphaseIIR`, `useIntegerLatency = true`, one instance pre-built per factor (1×/2×/4×/8×), `numChannels = 2`.

**Parameter count (reconciled 2026-08-28):** **45 APVTS parameters — 41 Float, 3 Choice, 1 Bool** (+ 3 non-automatable UI actions).
